description: Unit test class for the Coordinates class in the Qhull library, testing construction, conversion, element access, iteration, search, I/O, and other functionalities.

classes.name: Coordinates_test
classes.description: Test suite for the Coordinates class, testing various functionalities including construction, conversion, element access, iteration, search, and I/O.

methods.name: t_construct
methods.description: Tests the construction and copying of Coordinates objects, as well as basic arithmetic and comparison operations.

methods.name: t_convert
methods.description: Tests conversion between Coordinates and standard containers like std::vector and QList.

methods.name: t_element
methods.description: Tests element access, modification, and mid-slicing of Coordinates objects.

methods.name: t_readonly
methods.description: Tests read-only properties of Coordinates objects.

methods.name: t_operator
methods.description: Tests operators such as equality, inequality, addition, and compound assignment.

methods.name: t_const_iterator
methods.description: Tests const iterator functionality over Coordinates.

methods.name: t_iterator
methods.description: Tests mutable iterator functionality over Coordinates.

methods.name: t_foreach
methods.description: Tests iteration over feasible points in Qhull.

methods.name: t_search
methods.description: Tests search functions like contains, count, indexOf, lastIndexOf, and removal methods.

methods.name: t_readwrite
methods.description: Tests read/write operations including insertion, deletion, and modification of Coordinates.

methods.name: t_io
methods.description: Tests I/O streaming of Coordinates objects.
